storyCards.headline: High: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Cure's "High" reached #42 on the Billboard Hot 100. "High" is a song by English rock band the Cure, released on 16 March 1992 by Fiction Records as the lead single from their ninth album, Wish (1992).

The song peaked at #42 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

High was released in 1993.
